This issue affects RustDesk Server Pro: through 1.7.5. NOTE: the Supplier's position is that this is not a vulnerability.

CVE-2026-32148.description:
Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity vulnerability in hexpm hex (Hex.RemoteConverger module) allows dependency integrity bypass via unverified lockfile checksums.

Hex stores checksums for dependencies in the mix.lock file to ensure reproducible and integrity-checked builds. However, Hex.RemoteConverger.verify_resolved/2 never executes checksum verification because the lock data returned by Hex.Utils.lock/1 uses string-based dependency names, while the verification logic compares against atom-based names. This type mismatch causes the verification code path to be silently skipped. Checksums are still validated when packages are initially downloaded from the registry, but mismatches between the lockfile and resolved dependencies are not detected.

An attacker who can influence cached packages (e.g., via local cache poisoning or a compromised registry) can provide modified dependency contents that will be accepted without detection. The mix.lock file is silently rewritten with the checksum values from the registry, erasing evidence of tampering.

This issue affects hex: from 0.16.0 before 2.4.2.

CVE-2026-32146.description:
Improper path validation vulnerability in the Gleam compiler's handling of git dependencies allows arbitrary file system modification during dependency download.

Dependency names from gleam.toml and manifest.toml are incorporated into filesystem paths without sufficient validation or confinement to the intended dependency directory, allowing attacker-controlled paths (via relative traversal such as ../ or absolute paths) to target filesystem locations outside that directory. When resolving git dependencies (e.g. via gleam deps download), the computed path is used for filesystem operations including directory deletion and creation.

This vulnerability occurs during the dependency resolution and download phase, which is generally expected to be limited to fetching and preparing dependencies within a confined directory. A malicious direct or transitive git dependency can exploit this issue to delete and overwrite arbitrary directories outside the intended dependency directory, including attacker-chosen absolute paths, potentially causing data loss. In some environments, this may be further leveraged to achieve code execution, for example by overwriting git hooks or shell configuration files.

This issue affects gleam: from 1.9.0-rc1 before 1.15.4 and from 1.16.0-rc1 before 1.16.0-rc2.

CVE-2026-32135.description: NanoMQ MQTT Broker (NanoMQ) is an all-around Edge Messaging Platform. Versions prior to 0.24.11 have a remotely triggerable heap buffer overflow in the `uri_param_parse` function of NanoMQ's REST API. The vulnerability occurs due to an off-by-one error when allocating memory for query parameter keys and values, allowing an attacker to write a null byte beyond the allocated buffer. This can be triggered via a crafted HTTP request. Version 0.24.11 patches the issue.

CVE-2026-31635.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

rxrpc: fix oversized RESPONSE authenticator length check

rxgk_verify_response() decodes auth_len from the packet and is supposed
to verify that it fits in the remaining bytes. The existing check is
inverted, so oversized RESPONSE authenticators are accepted and passed
to rxgk_decrypt_skb(), which can later reach skb_to_sgvec() with an
impossible length and hit BUG_ON(len).

Decoded from the original latest-net reproduction logs with
scripts/decode_stacktrace.sh:

RIP: __skb_to_sgvec()
  [net/core/skbuff.c:5285 (discriminator 1)]
Call Trace:
 skb_to_sgvec() [net/core/skbuff.c:5305]
 rxgk_decrypt_skb() [net/rxrpc/rxgk_common.h:81]
 rxgk_verify_response() [net/rxrpc/rxgk.c:1268]
 rxrpc_process_connection()
   [net/rxrpc/conn_event.c:266 net/rxrpc/conn_event.c:364
    net/rxrpc/conn_event.c:386]
 process_one_work() [kernel/workqueue.c:3281]
 worker_thread()
   [kernel/workqueue.c:3353 kernel/workqueue.c:3440]
 kthread() [kernel/kthread.c:436]
 ret_from_fork() [arch/x86/kernel/process.c:164]

Reject authenticator lengths that exceed the remaining packet payload.

CVE-2026-31256.description: A null pointer dereference vulnerability exists in the RTSP service of the MERCURY MIPC252W 1.0.5 Build 230306 Rel.79931n. During the processing of a SETUP request for the path rtsp://<IP>:554/stream1/track2, the device fails to properly validate the Transport header field. When this header is improperly constructed, the RTSP service can dereference a NULL pointer during request parsing. Successful exploitation causes the device to crash and automatically reboot.

CVE-2026-30798.description:
Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity, Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in rustdesk-client RustDesk Client rustdesk-client on Windows, MacOS, Linux, iOS, Android (Heartbeat sync loop, strategy processing modules) allows Protocol Manipulation.

 This vulnerability is associated with program files src/hbbs_http/sync.Rs and program routines stop-service handler in heartbeat loop.



This issue affects RustDesk Client: through 1.4.8. NOTE: the Supplier's position is that this is not a vulnerability.

CVE-2026-30792.description:
A vulnerability in rustdesk-client RustDesk Client rustdesk-client on Windows, MacOS, Linux, iOS, Android, WebClient (Strategy sync, HTTP API client, config options engine modules) allows Application API Message Manipulation via Man-in-the-Middle.

 This vulnerability is associated with program files src/hbbs_http/sync.Rs, hbb_common/src/config.Rs and program routines Strategy merge loop in sync.Rs, Config::set_options().



This issue affects RustDesk Client: through 1.4.8. NOTE: some third parties have indicated that these details do not align with the Supplier's statements.

CVE-2026-30785.description:
Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution'), Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort vulnerability in rustdesk-client RustDesk Client rustdesk, hbb_common on Windows, MacOS, Linux (Password security module, config encryption, machine UID modules) allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data. This vulnerability is associated with program files hbb_common/src/password_security.Rs, hbb_common/src/config.Rs, hbb_common/src/lib.Rs (get_uuid), machine-uid/src/lib.Rs and program routines symmetric_crypt(), encrypt_str_or_original(), decrypt_str_or_original(), get_uuid(), get_machine_id().

This issue affects RustDesk Client: through 1.4.5. NOTE: some third parties have indicated that these details do not align with the Supplier's statements.

CVE-2026-30502.description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in OpenKM v6.3.12 allows attackers to execute arbitrary Javascript in the context of the user's browser via a crafted input injected into the Content parameter.

CVE-2026-22235.description: OPEXUS eComplaint before version 9.0.45.0 allows an attacker to visit the 'DocumentOpen.aspx' endpoint, iterate through predictable values of 'chargeNumber', and download any uploaded files.

CVE-2026-16118.description: A flaw was found in xdgmime. A heap-based buffer overflow can be triggered in _xdg_mime_magic_parse_magic_line() in the xdgmimemagic.c file on little-endian systems when an attacker-controlled MIME magic file in a user-writable XDG data location (e.g., in the $XDG_DATA_HOME/mime/magic path) is parsed by an application performing MIME type detection (e.g., via g_content_type_guess()). When performing byte-swap, incorrect pointer arithmetic on the write side causes an out-of-bounds write of 2 bytes, resulting in an application crash or memory corruption.

CVE-2026-14968.description:
EDK2 contains vulnerabilities in
BIOS where skilled and privileged users or attackers may cause “Out-of-bounds Write” by local access. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could compromise
SMM handler integrity, cause system instability, and lead to denial of service. It could also impact Integrity and Availability.

CVE-2026-132751.description: yt through 4.4.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute Python code by supplying a crafted con_args attribute in a ytdata HDF5 file. SavedDataset._parse_parameter_file() passes con_args to eval() unrestricted, so loading a malicious .h5 file with yt.load() runs attacker code as the user.

CVE-2026-132143.description: A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function doWebBackup of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component Backup Handler. Such manipulation of the argument path/value leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132141.description: A vulnerability was detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected by this issue is the function json_load_lock of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component Jsonstatus. The manipulation of the argument usefile results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 can resolve this issue. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132140.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file mainfunction.cgi of the component Apmcfg Upload. The manipulation leads to null pointer dereference. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132139.description: A weakness has been identified in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected is the function setSWMProfile of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. Executing a manipulation of the argument filename can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to address this issue. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132121.description: Supergateway 2.4.0 through 4.2.2 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking vulnerability in stdio-to-WebSocket mode that allows malicious web pages to connect by bypassing missing Origin header validation. Attackers can open the /message WebSocket from a victim's browser, even against localhost-bound gateways, to initialize an MCP session and invoke wrapped stdio MCP server tools with victim privileges.

CVE-2026-131857.description: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

CVE-2026-131854.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131848.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

CVE-2026-131844.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in CurlCachedFileLoader::init(). Malicious HTTP servers can return an enormous Content-Length so CachedFile resizes its chunk cache accordingly, aborting pdfinfo or PDFDocFactory-based applications with std::bad_alloc for denial of service.

CVE-2026-130857.description: EveryDocs Core before 1.6.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' records through unscoped Model.find(params[:id]) lookups in multiple controllers. Self-registered attackers can enumerate sequential ids to read, modify, or delete other users' documents and stored files, and rename or delete their folders, tags and people.

CVE-2026-130796.description: Flowise 3.1.3 through 3.1.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read MCP server bearer tokens via the GET /api/v1/public-chatflows/:id handler. Attackers can use the leaked mcpServerConfig token on the POST /api/v1/mcp/:chatflowId route to invoke chatflows, bypassing API key protection and consuming the owner's model quota.

CVE-2026-130791.description: Finsys Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users with stacks:edit permission to move arbitrary server directories by supplying a crafted oldDir parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/stacks/[name]/relocate with an unvalidated source path to relocate directories into stack paths, disrupting services and exposing their contents.

CVE-2026-130775.description: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest-API image export handler that fails to pin the project parameter to the guest's own project. Container root users with the guest-API image entitlement can supply another project in the project query parameter to export public or cached images, including non-public images pulled from authenticated remotes.

CVE-2026-130753.description: heym before 0.0.142 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Playwright step-mode node where _resolve_expressions_in_code substitutes workflow values directly into generated Python source. Authenticated non-admin users can craft step field values that break out of string literals to execute arbitrary Python as root inside the backend container.

CVE-2026-130751.description: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-travelmate on master before 3.0.0-1, on openwrt-25.12 before 2.4.9-6, and on openwrt-24.10 and openwrt-23.05 (no fix available) grants file exec permissions for state-mutating commands in the read scope of its rpcd ACL, letting authenticated read-only users run those commands as root. Attackers can invoke ubus file exec on /etc/init.d/travelmate setup, start, stop, restart, or /sbin/ifup to modify and commit network and firewall configuration or disrupt the travelmate daemon.

CVE-2026-130627.description: The Vert.x HTTP client transport (a2a-java-sdk-http-client-vertx) hand-rolls a POST redirect follower that, when the documented PostBuilder.followRedirects(true) opt-in is enabled, re-issues the redirected request with the full request header map copied verbatim and performs no credential stripping and no same-authority check. A malicious, compromised, or mistyped agent that returns a 30x response with an absolute cross-host Location causes the client to forward the standard Authorization header (Bearer/Basic/OAuth) — plus every other header, including the allowlisted API-key headers — to the attacker-controlled authority. This breaks the project's own cross-transport invariant (SECURITY.md §8, OkHttpPostRedirectHeaderLeakTest) that credentials are stripped on cross-authority redirects even when redirects are followed. The sibling JDK and OkHttp/Android transports strip Authorization; Vert.x uniquely does not. This is a "fix introduced the bug" variant — the follower was added by the GHSA-9rhm hardening PR (3ae82912, refined by a5e76a0b).

CVE-2026-130626.description: The core JDK HTTP client (a2a-java-sdk-http-client) applies the GHSA-9rhm redirect-neutralization only to the POST path. JdkGetBuilder.get(), JdkGetBuilder.getAsyncSSE(), and JdkDeleteBuilder.delete() call the injected httpClient directly, with no redirect gate. An application that supplies a redirect-capable HttpClient (Redirect.NORMAL/ALWAYS) — which is the SDK-documented way to enable POST redirects — silently follows cross-authority redirects on every credentialed GET/DELETE request. The JDK strips Authorization cross-origin, but forwards the four allowlisted custom credential headers (X-API-Key, API-Key, X-Auth-Token, X-Authentication) to the attacker-controlled authority. This is an incomplete-fix variant of GHSA-9rhm: the fix hardened the default client and added a POST-only two-step opt-in, but never covered GET/DELETE.

CVE-2026-130591.description: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by requesting /api/files/:file_id/preview and /api/file-version/:file_body_id without UserTokenAuth. Attackers can enumerate sequential numeric ids to read raw knowledge-base files and stored file versions belonging to any enterprise tenant.

CVE-2026-130382.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OtpLoginPlugin that allows attackers knowing the database password to skip TOTP verification by abusing the permanent-login cookie. Attackers can submit a login with a wrong OTP and permanent=1 to obtain a neo_permanent cookie, then replay it to gain full authenticated database access.

CVE-2026-130374.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying crafted IN and NOT IN search values that process_length() passes unescaped. Attackers can send a logged-in user a cross-site GET link using a backslash-escaped apostrophe to run blind SQL with that user's database rights on PostgreSQL, SQLite, MS SQL, Oracle, or MySQL in NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES mode.

CVE-2026-130361.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a parameter injection vulnerability in its ClickHouse driver that allows attackers to inject ClickHouse HTTP query parameters through an unencoded db GET parameter. Attackers can lure a logged-in victim into opening a crafted GET link that injects a query parameter, bypassing the POST-only CSRF token. ClickHouse then executes attacker-chosen SQL under the victim's credentials to read, modify, or drop data.

CVE-2026-130357.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in updateUserRights that lets USER_EDIT admins drop category restrictions on group rights. Attackers can re-save rights through the user update-rights API to convert category-restricted group rights into global direct rights, then edit, publish or delete FAQs in withheld categories.

CVE-2026-130072.description: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

CVE-2026-129985.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, a user-controlled schedule appName is joined into the schedule directory path and interpolated without shell quoting into commands that create the directory and write the schedule script. An authenticated user who can create or update a dokploy-server schedule can inject operating-system commands that execute with the Dokploy process privileges when the schedule is saved, including root privileges on typical installations. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129880.description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.5 through 3.8.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows registered users to leak server-wide GitLab or Gitea tokens via repository_url. Attackers can create a gitlab or gitea project pointing to a controlled host and request its branches to capture the operator's token and reach internal hosts.

CVE-2026-129879.description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.

CVE-2026-129494.description: CloudPaste 1.1.0 through 1.9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain WebDAV storage credentials through the unauthenticated /api/proxy/link endpoint. Attackers who know a public share slug can retrieve the Basic Authorization header containing the WebDAV username and password, then read, modify, or delete files on the WebDAV server.

CVE-2026-129493.description: Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7 through 2.6.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read article view passwords via the public GET /articles endpoint. Attackers can retrieve the plaintext articleViewPwd field returned by ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage and submit it to read password-protected article content.

CVE-2026-129452.description: A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function set_table of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument jsondata leads to command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-129451.description: A flaw has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This affects the function app_guest_export of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. This manipulation of the argument filename causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to mitigate this issue. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-129445.description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-850L FW1.20WWb03. This impacts an unknown function of the file /usr/sbin/consolepwd of the component Console Login. Performing a manipulation results in hard-coded credentials. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-129315.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). In 0.31.0 and earlier, the hosted installer and manual installation instructions set /etc/dokploy to mode 0777, allowing a local non-root user on a shared host to replace root-owned schedule or Traefik configuration directories. Dokploy subsequently consumes those paths as trusted configuration and can execute substituted scheduled-task scripts as root, resulting in local privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-129302.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 3.5.0 until 3.13.0, built-in penetration-detection patterns in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py execute through a direct pattern.search(content) call instead of the timeout-protected create_safe_matcher() path used for custom patterns. The built-in template-injection detector contains an unbounded expression with quadratic behavior when scanning repeated opening braces. Because penetration detection and enhanced mode are enabled by a stock SecurityConfig, an unauthenticated request can block the shared asyncio event loop, affecting all application endpoints. The triggering input does not produce a detection match, so the request can complete without incrementing ban counters or being recorded as suspicious. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

CVE-2026-129250.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Edimax BR6478ACV2 1.23. The impacted element is the function formPPTPSetup of the file webs. The manipulation of the argument pptpUserName leads to buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-129166.description: Keep 0.34.10 through 0.55.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in its CEL-to-SQL converter, which inserts bracket-indexed JSON keys from CEL filters unescaped into JSON path expressions for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Authenticated users with read:alert permission can submit crafted CEL expressions to /alerts/query or the cel parameter of /incidents, using result counts as a boolean oracle to extract other tenants' alerts and password hashes.

CVE-2026-129162.description: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in FileStreamController.preview that allows unauthenticated attackers to download stored files. Attackers who obtain a file ID from share listings or preview links can request /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} to download any user's or workspace's files.

CVE-2026-129153.description: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authorization bypass in the linked survey feature that fails to verify the referenced linkSurveyId belongs to the caller's own project. Authenticated attackers can point a linked option at another user's survey so that loadLinkResult and updateLinkSurveyAnswer read, rewrite, or create responses in that survey.

CVE-2026-129149.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, using the mosquitto_ctrl utility in interactive shell mode to interact with a malicious server could result in a crash of the utility if the server sent a hostile response.

CVE-2026-129143.description: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ArticleRestController article detail endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted articles. Attackers can enumerate article IDs via GET /article/api/data/detail/{articleId} to retrieve full content of paid, login-only, member-only and draft articles.

CVE-2026-129139.description: paicoding from commit b8206b9 through commit 903adce uses predictable credentials for accounts created via ZSXQ login, because loginByZsxq derives both the username and password solely from the member's ZSXQ number. Unauthenticated attackers can read that number from the victim's /user/{userId} profile page, compute the credentials, and log in via /login/username to take over the account.

CVE-2026-129117.description: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows machine-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate Telnet servers because ssl_reply() never calls ssl_check_server_name(). Attackers can refuse START-TLS, offer Telnet AUTHENTICATION SSL, and present any trusted CA certificate to capture user credentials and session data.

CVE-2026-128669.description: A Session Fixation vulnerability exists in the admin login endpoint (/admin/index.php) of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1. The application fails to regenerate the session identifier (PHPSESSID) upon successful authentication. A remote attacker can exploit this by setting a known session ID in the victim's browser prior to login. Once the victim authenticates, the attacker can reuse the fixed session ID to hijack the victim's authenticated session.

CVE-2026-128668.description: An Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in the admin panel of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1 allows authenticated attackers to upload files with arbitrary content by bypassing weak filename extension validation in add-post.php and change-image.php. Although files are renamed with an image extension upon storage, the lack of MIME type and content validation enables content spoofing, storage of malicious markup, and creates a vector for Remote Code Execution (RCE) with server misconfigurations or secondary Local File Inclusion.

CVE-2026-128664.description: An insecure password reset vulnerability in the Admin Password Recovery Module of PHPGurukul News Portal Project v4.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to change an administrator or sub-administrator account password by providing the corresponding username and email address. The application does not require verification of account ownership through an email token, OTP, or another authentication mechanism before updating the password, potentially resulting in account takeover.

CVE-2026-128346.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource leak vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookReader.parse that leaves temporary files and open descriptors when sheet parsing fails or iteration stops early. Attackers can repeatedly upload malformed multi-sheet workbooks with worksheets placed before xl/sharedStrings.xml to fill the temporary directory and exhaust file descriptors.

CVE-2026-128344.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an unbounded image anchor column in the drawing part. Attackers can set an anchor column such as 300000000 in xl/drawings/drawing1.xml so reading getImages() anchor positions makes Worksheet.getColumn allocate millions of Column objects and abort with a heap out-of-memory error.

CVE-2026-128342.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying an unbounded sheetId in xl/workbook.xml. Attackers can provide a workbook with a huge sheetId, making the sparse worksheet array walk stall worksheets, getWorksheet and writeBuffer for seconds.

CVE-2026-128341.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in data-validations-xform.js that allows attackers to exhaust CPU and memory by supplying unbounded sqref ranges. Attackers can provide a small crafted workbook with a sqref of A1:XFD1048576 to make xlsx.load() iterate billions of addresses, blocking the event loop and crashing the process with an uncatchable out-of-memory error.

CVE-2026-128340.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an oversized defined-name range. DefinedNames.addEx expands ranges such as S!$A$1:$XFD$1048576 from xl/workbook.xml cell by cell, causing an uncatchable fatal heap out-of-memory error during xlsx.load().

CVE-2026-128338.description: exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a worksheet col element with an unbounded max attribute. Attackers can craft a small workbook with a huge max value, causing xlsx.load() to allocate hundreds of millions of Column objects and abort the process with an uncatchable heap out-of-memory error.

CVE-2026-128337.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in mergeConditionalFormattings that allows attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying an x14:cfRule id of __proto__. Attackers can craft an xlsx file that, when loaded with xlsx.load(), sets properties such as type, direction, border and cfvo on every object in the process until it restarts.

CVE-2026-128329.description: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to read arbitrary files by supplying ../ sequences in the filePath of patch.readRepoFile. Attackers with service read permission can read /etc/shadow, SSH private keys, and secret environment files on the Dokploy host or managed remote servers.

CVE-2026-128134.description: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, nltk.parse.dependencygraph.dot2img resolves the Graphviz dot executable through PATH but invokes the resulting absolute executable without routing through spawn_trusted, so resolve_trusted_executable ownership and writability validation and safe_env loader environment scrubbing do not run. A local low-privileged attacker who can write to a directory on a POSIX victim's PATH can plant or replace dot, and code executes as the victim when dot2img is called directly or DependencyGraph.repr_svg renders a graph. The current-working-directory-only bare-name vector is blocked and is not this vulnerability; this issue is the residual writable absolute PATH element bypass after CVE-2026-78680. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

CVE-2026-128089.description: dnspython is a DNS toolkit for Python. Prior to version 2.9.2, the from_text() parser for WKS records does not require the service number to be between 0 and 65535 before using it as a bitmap offset. An attacker-controlled zone file can supply a larger number, causing the service bitmap to grow to an extremely large size through inefficient repeated extension, consuming excessive memory and CPU and potentially terminating the process. Applications are affected only when they parse zone-file text whose record type and rdata are attacker controlled. This issue is fixed in version 2.9.2.

CVE-2026-128082.description: AutoMapper is a convention-based object-object mapper in .NET. Prior to 15.1.4 and from 16.0.0 until 16.3.0, AutoMapper increments type depth only after creating the destination, so recursive mapping performed through constructor parameters occurs before MaxDepth is counted. Destinations built through positional records or other constructors, and recursive ConstructUsing mappings that call context.Mapper, can therefore bypass explicit MaxDepth values and the default limit of 64. Deep attacker-influenced input can throw an uncatchable StackOverflowException and terminate the process. This issue is fixed in versions 15.1.4 and 16.3.0.

CVE-2026-128073.description: gosaml2 is a Pure Go implementation of SAML 2.0. Prior to 0.12.0, ValidateEncodedResponse() calls decryptAssertions() on an EncryptedAssertion before signature or content validation completes, and EncryptedAssertion.DecryptBytes() in types/encrypted_assertion.go slices decoded ciphertext without first validating the required nonce or initialization-vector length. A CipherValue shorter than the 12-byte AES-GCM nonce causes a slice-bounds panic, and an empty AES-CBC CipherValue passes the modulo block-size check before causing a slice-bounds panic at the 16-byte initialization-vector split. An attacker needs only the service provider's public certificate to wrap a symmetric key, and no valid identity-provider signature or relationship is required. The unrecovered panic can terminate the request goroutine or the service process. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.0.

CVE-2026-128066.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. From 1.0 through 12.3.0, ImageFileDirectory_v2.load() in src/PIL/TiffImagePlugin.py retains a separate bytes object for each out-of-line IFD tag value without limiting the total data read or preventing distinct tags from referencing the same file region. A small crafted TIFF or EXIF-bearing JPEG, PNG, WebP, or MPO can therefore cause memory use quadratic in the input size. TIFF and some JPEG paths trigger parsing during Image.open(), while other formats are exposed when EXIF is requested, including through getexif() or ImageOps.exif_transpose(). The declared pixel dimensions do not bound this metadata allocation, so decompression-bomb checks do not prevent process memory exhaustion. This issue is fixed in version 13.0.0.

CVE-2026-128015.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that leaves a dangling pointer to a freed environment table when putenv() is called during request shutdown. Attackers triggering putenv() in shutdown functions, destructors, or session handlers can crash the process on the next getenv() call or leak previous request environment values.

CVE-2026-127222.description: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

CVE-2026-127078.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to attach another application's environment to their service by supplying a foreign project_env_id. Attackers can configure CI and trigger builds and deployments through the component env endpoints using the other application's configuration, registries and deployment infrastructure.

CVE-2026-127076.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to list and build from Git repositories restricted to other projects. Attackers can enumerate repositories via GET /api/v1/git_repo/?all=true and submit any git_repo_id to the ci endpoint, cloning other projects' source code, manifests, and committed secrets.

CVE-2026-126938.description: Zipline before 4.6.4 contains a resource allocation vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass chunked-upload size and quota checks by forging Content-Range offsets and totals. Attackers can send tiny chunks to the partial upload endpoint with large declared offsets, causing the server to create oversized files and exhaust disk space.

CVE-2026-126805.description: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated Videos Admin users to obtain video_id_hash values bound to any video owner via encoder endpoints like aVideoEncoderStatus.json.php. Attackers can request the hash for an administrator-owned video and replay it through useVideoHashOrLogin() for password-less login, gaining plugin upload, configuration, and user management access.

CVE-2026-126804.description: WWBN AVideo 12.4 through 29.7.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the ADs plugin deleteImage.json.php that allows authenticated users with custom ads to delete arbitrary files. Attackers can set the unvalidated is_regular_user parameter to another user's id or ../ sequences to delete other users' ads or files like videos/configuration.php, taking the site offline and re-exposing the installer.

CVE-2026-126802.description: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains hardcoded HTTP Basic Auth credentials in ns-admin's AuthAgent and AuthExternal routers that allow unauthenticated attackers to access protected APIs. Attackers can call /agent/config to obtain Redis passwords, etcd details and the server token, and impersonate scan nodes via registration, heartbeat and logging endpoints.

CVE-2026-126769.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access Governance API endpoints, including /api/v1/databases. Attackers can send requests without an Authorization header, or with invalid or tampered JWT tokens, to retrieve stored database hosts, usernames, and passwords.

CVE-2026-126706.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the mosquitto_ctrl utility would crash if attempting to interact with a hostile broker and the broker sent a non-string "error" value.

CVE-2026-126494.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in ScopeRepository::finalizeScopes() that allows read-only SMART/OAuth clients to obtain write scopes because ScopeEntity::containsScope() ignores registered permissions. Attackers with a client registered for user/<resource>.read can request user/<resource>.write to create, update, and delete appointments or patient data.

CVE-2026-126491.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in getByPatientDemographics() where layout_options field_id values are concatenated into the patient search WHERE clause. Attackers with Layout Editor access can plant a malicious field_id, allowing any authenticated low-privilege user to exfiltrate data from patient_data and users_secure tables.

CVE-2026-126487.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to override system-wide global configuration values by storing global-prefixed keys through library/ajax/user_settings.php. Attackers can submit lab or target parameters with global: prefixed setting names to disable audit logging, weaken password policies, or alter security-sensitive settings persistently for their sessions.

CVE-2026-126486.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in portal/import_template.php, where several portal document template modes lack admin/forms ACL and CSRF checks. Any authenticated staff user can send mode=save_profiles to delete all template profile assignments, use other unguarded modes to push templates to patients or change categories, and read template bodies via mode=get or getPdf.

CVE-2026-126482.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SLEOB::slInvoiceNumber() in src/Billing/SLEOB.php, which concatenates the CLP01 claim identifier from uploaded X12 835 ERA files into a query without escaping or parameter binding. Authenticated users with billing permissions, or a malicious payer whose ERA file a clerk uploads, can execute arbitrary SQL to read any table, including users_secure password hashes, and modify data.

CVE-2026-126481.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in era_payments.php and sl_eob_search.php that allows authenticated billing users to write files outside the ERA directory. Attackers can embed traversal sequences in the GS04 element of an uploaded X12 835 file to overwrite .edi or .835 files with attacker-controlled content anywhere writable by the web server.

CVE-2026-126471.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in print_referral.php and trend_form.php that allows low-privileged Front Office users to access patient PHI without patients:med permission. Attackers can directly request these endpoints with arbitrary patient_id values to retrieve patient demographics, insurance data, and vitals history, enumerating IDs to expand disclosure.

CVE-2026-126470.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the Carecoordination module that allows authenticated users with send_to_hie permission to access any patient's CCDA/CCR/QRDA documents. Attackers can supply arbitrary document or patient IDs to download, transmit, or export patient health records, inject falsified clinical data, and delete audit records.

CVE-2026-126469.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in several custom/ scripts that rely only on session authentication and never call AclMain::aclCheckCore(). Any authenticated low-privilege user can request export_labworks.php, chart_tracker.php, or export_registry_xml.php to disclose patient SSN, DOB, and insurance data or provider NPI/tax IDs, and forge chart-tracker records.

CVE-2026-126467.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in ObservationController::processEnhancedFormSave() that allows authenticated low-privilege users to forge authorization flags through an incomplete field blacklist. Attackers can submit authorized=1 or override the id field alongside observation_id to mark observations as Provider-signed and overwrite clinical fields of other observations within the same patient encounter.

CVE-2026-126466.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create patient records and enumerate patients by omitting aclCheckCore() checks. Attackers can POST to new_comprehensive_save.php to create patients with insurance PHI, or query new_search_popup.php and patient_select.php to leak names, SSNs and DOBs.

CVE-2026-126465.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the patient portal api/onsiteactivityviews endpoint that allows any authenticated staff user to inject SQL through unquoted Id_BitwiseAnd Criteria values. Attackers can close the bitwise parenthesis and append OR or UNION SELECT clauses to read patient PHI, staff password hashes, MySQL authentication strings, and API tokens.

CVE-2026-126463.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple sql injection vulnerabilities that allow authenticated users to inject payloads through ERA CLP01, form_facility, form_icd_codes, and POST key names. Attackers can perform UNION, blind, and error-based injection to read users_secure password hashes and patient PHI, and overwrite patient_data fields.

CVE-2026-126461.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/user_settings.php that lets any authenticated user persist arbitrary global configuration overrides. Attackers can POST global:-prefixed keys to re-point external service hosts like CouchDB, eRx, phiMail, or SMTP to attacker-controlled servers, exfiltrating system credentials and patient PHI.

CVE-2026-126458.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in authorizations_full.php that allows any authenticated staff user to authorize arbitrary patients' clinical records. Attackers can send a mode=authorize request with an attacker-chosen pid and their own CSRF token to set authorized=1 on billing, forms, pnotes, and transactions records, bypassing provider review.

CVE-2026-126457.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in InstallerController that allows any authenticated user to modify module administration settings without the admin/manage_modules permission. Low-privileged users such as Front Office clerks can POST to saveConfig, DeleteAcl, DeleteHooks and nickName actions to reconfigure or partially disable installed modules.

CVE-2026-126454.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 lacks rate limiting or lockout on TOTP submission, allowing attackers with a valid password to brute-force the 6-digit MFA code. Attackers can script repeated POST requests to main_screen.php or the OAuth2 authorization flow with re-submitted hidden credentials to bypass two-factor authentication.

CVE-2026-126453.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an inverted comparison in Document::has_expired() that causes the FHIR Binary download endpoint to treat time-limited PHI documents as unexpired after their one-hour lifetime. Authenticated users still authorized for a Binary/{id} resource can download expired bulk export NDJSON files and $docref CCDs indefinitely.

CVE-2026-126452.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in diagnosis_full.php that allows authenticated users to delete or clear any billing record by ID. Attackers can supply a target billing ID in the id parameter with delete or clear mode to deactivate other patients' charges and corrupt financial records.

CVE-2026-126442.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in create_portallogin.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to replace patient portal credentials without ACL checks. Attackers can select a victim patient in session and post replacement credentials to take over portal accounts, read PHI, and lock patients out.

CVE-2026-126437.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in portal/lib/download_template.php that allows any authenticated core user to render documents for arbitrary patients by setting isModule. Attackers can submit arbitrary pid and template_id values to disclose patient names, birth dates, chart IDs, addresses, allergies, medications, and problem lists despite ACL and squad restrictions.

CVE-2026-126434.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/forms/procedure_order/common.php that allows authenticated accounts lacking patients/lab permission to read and modify other patients' procedure orders. Attackers can request a global order id to disclose clinical history, or select the target patient in their session and submit bn_save to falsify diagnoses, instructions, and order status.

CVE-2026-126430.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandapprove controller. Attackers can embed scalar subqueries in the UPDATE patient_data SET clause to read staff password hashes and portal reset values, alter arbitrary patient demographics, and take over patient-portal accounts.

CVE-2026-126429.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 passes authenticated user-controlled HTML from the doc_lib.php content parameter to mPDF, which resolves local files and nested SVG resources. Authenticated patients or core users can submit crafted CSS imports or php://filter SVG references to read arbitrary server files including credentials and OAuth keys.

CVE-2026-126428.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated billing users to store attacker-controlled PHP by uploading a malformed ERA file to era_payments.php. Attackers with a database-write primitive such as SQL injection can register a background_services row whose require_once loads the stored .edi file, executing PHP as the web-server user.

CVE-2026-126416.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in patient_tracker_status.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to modify other patients' tracker entries by supplying arbitrary tracker_id values. Attackers can post statustype and roomnum parameters with a valid CSRF token to alter patient-flow status, room assignments, and linked calendar appointment state.

CVE-2026-126370.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing restricted site_admin roles to inject PHP by saving .sql files through the admin code editor. Attackers can bypass extension and content deny-lists with an @IF macro payload that compiles into executable PHP when the model loads, running OS commands as the web user.

CVE-2026-126304.description: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink escape vulnerability in YCOECorpusReader that allows attackers to read files outside the corpus root by planting psd or pos directory symlinks. Attackers controlling a YCOE corpus can make parsed_sents() and tagged_words() return file content from other corpora or temporary files within the NLTK data sandbox.

CVE-2026-126303.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() that lacks any max_time deadline or step limit. Attackers influencing the grammar can supply an ambiguous self-embedding grammar and short token input to force unbounded top-down search, pinning CPU cores and exhausting worker pools.

CVE-2026-126299.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the CCG lexicon parser fromstring that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying wide inputs. Attackers can submit lexicon text with long flat bracket bodies or operator chains, triggering quadratic string re-slicing in matchBrackets and augParseCategory that blocks worker threads.

CVE-2026-126297.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a quadratic-time denial of service vulnerability in ConllCorpusReader._get_srl_instances that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through nested span rescans. Attackers can supply a crafted CoNLL SRL corpus with many predicates and span columns, placing the head span last, to pin a core for minutes.

CVE-2026-126295.description: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in BllipParser that allows attackers to open files outside NLTK data roots by supplying unvalidated model paths. Attackers controlling parser_model, reranker_features, reranker_weights, or from_unified_model_dir() input can make the bllipparser C extension read sensitive files or block on FIFOs and devices.

CVE-2026-126264.description: SiYuan before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated Reader users to retrieve credential-named widget files by bypassing the sensitive-path guard in getFile. Attackers can request paths like /data/widgets/<package>/credentials.json for publish-referenced widgets to obtain API keys, tokens, or other stored secrets.

CVE-2026-126191.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 3.0, the CSS_ESCAPES and IDENTIFIER regular-expression subpatterns can backtrack exponentially on runs of ambiguous digit escapes in an attribute-name or tag position of an otherwise valid selector. The failure occurs during selector compilation through soupsieve.compile() or Beautiful Soup select() before SELECTOR_LIMIT is applied, so an application that accepts untrusted selector strings can have a worker stalled by a short input. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.

CVE-2026-125958.description:
Download of code without integrity check vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Remote Code Inclusion.

This issue affects N-central: through 24.6.1.

CVE-2026-125759.description: Nango before 0.71.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL by supplying a crafted task group key to the orchestrator API. Attackers can send a malicious group.key to POST /v1/immediate, which TaskEventsHandler.notify() interpolates into a Postgres NOTIFY statement, running stacked queries against the scheduler database.

CVE-2026-125755.description: Nodemailer 3.0.0 before 10.4.1 contains an address parsing flaw in addressparser that truncates domains at folding whitespace or comments before a dot, allowing attackers to bypass recipient domain restrictions. Attackers can submit crafted to, cc, bcc or replyTo addresses that pass RFC 5322 domain checks but deliver mail to an attacker-chosen address under the application's sender identity.

CVE-2026-125754.description: Dolibarr 20.0.0 through 23.0.4 and 24.x before 24.0.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in api_expensereports.class.php payment endpoints that lets authenticated users access other users' expense report payments. Attackers with only expense report read and create rights can call getAllPayments, getPayments, addPayment, or updatePayment to read, create, or modify payments, falsifying reimbursement state.

CVE-2026-125742.description: 7-Zip before 26.06 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the LZX decoder that lets attackers corrupt memory when a continuation CAB volume declares a smaller window. Attackers can entice victims to extract crafted multi-volume CAB archives, where a stale _pos value bypasses bounds checks, enabling arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2026-125637.description: A flaw was found in the Konflux UI proxy. Hostname values defined in the KonfluxUI custom resource are inserted directly into proxy configuration files without adequate validation or sanitization. An authenticated user with permissions to modify the custom resource can inject malicious configuration directives to bypass authentication and authorization controls, potentially exposing internal backend services. In addition, providing malformed input can cause the configuration generator to fail, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) by preventing the proxy from starting.

CVE-2026-125398.description: Instatic before 0.0.21 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in handleRowAuthor that allows authenticated users to skip table-level access checks by loading rows with getDataRow() instead of loadRowForAccess(). Attackers holding content.edit.any but lacking data.system.tables.read can send PATCH requests to /admin/api/cms/data/rows/:id/author to read system-table rows and reassign their authors.

CVE-2026-124492.description: SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ModalAnchorEditor's #createBookmarkList, which inserts entity-decoded h1-h6 header textContent into the bookmark list via innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can store HTML-encoded payloads in editor headers that execute JavaScript when a victim opens the link modal and types # in the URL input.

CVE-2026-124489.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in portal/portal_payment.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to bypass billing ACL checks by tampering patient identifiers. Attackers can modify the pid and form_pid parameters to view payment pages and record fraudulent payment receipts for arbitrary patients, corrupting billing records.

CVE-2026-124488.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clinicians lacking high-sensitivity permission to read and modify encounter-bound forms via load_form.php. Attackers can request the Clinical Notes or Care Plan direct loader to obtain restricted content and a CSRF token, then submit save.php to tamper with clinical records.

CVE-2026-124487.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the non-patient POST /fhir/DocumentReference/$docref route that allows low-privileged users to generate any patient's CCDA. Attackers with only demographics and documents permissions can supply a victim patient parameter, then download the full-chart CCDA from Patient Documents to exfiltrate clinical data.

CVE-2026-124485.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the patient portal onsitedocuments API that allows authenticated patients to read other patients' documents by overriding query criteria. Attackers can send empty pid_Equals and denialReason_IsNotLike parameters to remove patient scoping and locked filters, exposing consent bodies, signatures, file paths, and template data.

CVE-2026-124484.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in portal onsite-document APIs that allows any authenticated core user to access cross-patient documents. Attackers can omit the patientId parameter and supply arbitrary record IDs to list, read, and overwrite other patients' portal documents, signatures, and template data.

CVE-2026-124483.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because the prescription REST API routes check the patients.med ACL instead of patients.rx and request no specific permission bit, so read-only Medical/History access passes the check. Authenticated staff users can reuse the UI-exposed APICSRFTOKEN to enumerate prescription UUIDs, forge prescriptions for arbitrary patients, and deactivate existing prescriptions tenant-wide.

CVE-2026-124481.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in Rainforest patient portal payments that trusts browser-supplied patientId, encounter, and amount values instead of deriving them from the portal session. Authenticated portal patients can tamper with JSON sent to portal_payment.rainforest.php so the payin.authorized webhook writes forged ar_activity credits to other patients' encounters exceeding the amount actually paid.

CVE-2026-124480.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read cross-patient FHIR QuestionnaireResponse data by sending the APICSRFTOKEN header. Attackers can reuse the session-exposed api_csrf_token_js value to skip FHIR scope checks and call GET /fhir/QuestionnaireResponse, exfiltrating site-wide questionnaire answer PHI.

CVE-2026-124479.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an arbitrary local file read vulnerability in REST document download, where the controller passes stored uploaded document bytes to Symfony's BinaryFileResponse as a filesystem path instead of returning them as content. Authenticated users with document upload and download access can upload a document containing an absolute pathname, such as the sqlconf.php location, then download it to read server files and recover database credentials.

CVE-2026-124477.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete arbitrary patient recall records via the delete_Recall action. Attackers can send POST requests to /interface/main/messages/save.php with a target pid and r_ID to remove recall data without ACL or ownership checks.

CVE-2026-124476.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference in portal/lib/paylib.php, which writes the request-supplied form_pid (or the patient_id_cc value in Sphere data) to onsite_portal_activity without checking it against the session patient. Authenticated portal patients can submit portal-save, review-save, AuthorizeNet, Stripe, or Sphere requests to insert or modify forged payment-audit records in other patients' billing records.

CVE-2026-124475.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in portal/lib/persist.php that allows authenticated portal patients to modify other patients' settings by supplying an arbitrary setting_patient value. Attackers can insert or overwrite patient_settings rows for victims to suppress notifications, tamper with consent flags, or alter portal preferences.

CVE-2026-124472.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_patient_note.php that allows any authenticated user to read and modify patient billing notes. Attackers with low-privilege accounts can enumerate the patient_id parameter and submit POST requests using the embedded CSRF token to view or tamper with confidential billing data.

CVE-2026-124471.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php that allows any authenticated user to read and modify billing data for any encounter. Attackers can iterate the id parameter to read patient names and billing notes, and post payments, adjustments, deletions, or billing notes against any patient's account.

CVE-2026-124470.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken object level authorization vulnerability in portal/report/portal_custom_report.php that allows authenticated portal patients to read other patients' problem list entries. Attackers can enumerate sequential IDs in issue_ parameter names to retrieve other patients' problem titles, clinical notes, ICD diagnosis codes, and IPPF contraceptive records.

CVE-2026-124468.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Standard REST API patient insurance and employer search, which concatenates query-string parameter names into SQL as column identifiers without escaping. Authenticated clients, including low-privilege patient-portal OAuth2 tokens, can send crafted parameter names to /api/patient/{puuid}/insurance or /api/patient/{puuid}/employer to extract patient PHI, user records, and API client secrets.

CVE-2026-124467.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a local file inclusion in the ESign router (library/ESign/Router.php), which passes the unsanitized module parameter into a require_once of '<module>/Controller.php', and the fax module's faxProcessUploads writes attacker-named files to a predictable temp path without extension checks. Authenticated attackers can upload a PHP file named Controller.php, then request interface/esign/index.php with a traversing module parameter to include it and execute arbitrary code.

CVE-2026-124465.description: Trendyol kafka-konsumer from 2.3.3 before 2.6.18 contains a denial of service vulnerability in batch_consumer.go that panics when a single record exceeds MessageGroupByteSizeLimit. Attackers able to produce to the consumed topic can publish one oversized record that terminates the consumer before offset commit, causing a persistent crash loop.

CVE-2026-124462.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in OnsiteDocumentController::Query() that allows authenticated portal patients to bypass the lowercase pid authorization guard by supplying a capitalised Pid parameter. Attackers can request the api/onsitedocuments endpoint with Pid set to another patient's id to overwrite the session-pinned criteria and read other patients' onsite documents containing PHI.

CVE-2026-124461.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/upload.php that allows any authenticated user to read and overwrite document data by supplying an arbitrary doc_id. Low-privilege users can enumerate doc_id values with the fetch and save actions to disclose patient health information and tamper with medical records across all patients.

CVE-2026-124459.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in many encounter-form view and save endpoints that lack patient/encounter ownership checks. Authenticated clinical users can enumerate sequential form id values in requests such as soap/view.php and save.php to read and overwrite other patients' clinical records.

CVE-2026-124458.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the FHIR GET /fhir/Person/:uuid route that allows patient-portal users to read any staff member's demographics by bypassing compartment enforcement. Attackers holding a patient SMART token with patient/Person.read can harvest staff Person UUIDs from Appointment references to retrieve names, home addresses, phone numbers, and personal emails.

CVE-2026-124457.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_process.php that allows authenticated users to write and read files by supplying unsanitized eraname values. Attackers without billing privileges can inject ../ sequences to create ERA report .html files anywhere the web user can write and parse arbitrary .edi files echoed into the report.

CVE-2026-124455.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in OnsiteDocumentController::Query() that allows authenticated portal patients to read other patients' documents by overriding Pid_Equals criteria. Attackers can supply Pid_Equals, Pid_GreaterThan, or Pid_In request parameters to the onsitedocuments API to retrieve signed consent forms, signatures, and PHI of any patient.

CVE-2026-124453.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in portal/lib/persist.php that allows authenticated portal patients to write settings for other patients. Attackers can modify the setting_patient parameter in a JSON POST request to another patient's PID, altering that patient's portal settings such as the portal theme.

CVE-2026-124017.description: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into the unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page read by the BootROM. By overwriting a fuse-derived RAM variable via a crafted patch entry using Phison Vendor Specific Commands, an attacker can force CRC-only firmware verification instead of signature checking, enabling an unsigned firmware image to load and creating a persistent controller-level implant that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host operating system.

CVE-2026-124008.description: XWEB EVO 5.2.3 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the devices.lua template handling, which allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting unescaped template source into unzip and related shell commands. Attackers can exploit this flaw through the wlua interpreter to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the affected device. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

CVE-2026-123998.description: Hisense VIDAA Smart TV firmware V0000.01.00a.P0220 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its remote-control MQTT broker on TCP port 36669, which accepts publicly documented default credentials and an ineffective 4-digit pairing PIN with no rate limiting or lockout, allowing a brute force of the entire code space in about five seconds, while some actions require no pairing at all. A LAN-adjacent attacker can exploit this to inject key events, change volume, switch input sources, enumerate inputs, launch arbitrary installed applications, and monitor pairing activity, posing a significant risk in hotel deployments where untrusted LAN access is common.

CVE-2026-123997.description: Hisense VIDAA Smart TV firmware V0000.01.00a.P0220 contains an unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability in the UPnP/DLNA AVTransport SOAP service that allows LAN-adjacent attackers to freeze the entire television software layer by sending a crafted SetAVTransportURI request on TCP port 38400. Attackers can exploit this flaw without credentials to render the device completely unresponsive to remote control or front-panel input, requiring a physical power cycle to restore functionality.

CVE-2026-123993.description: Hisense VIDAA Smart TV firmware V0000.01.00a.P0220 contains an unauthenticated access vulnerability where a QA build of the Google Cobalt browser engine exposes the WebDriver automation server on TCP port 4444 across all network interfaces without any authentication or pairing requirement. A LAN-adjacent attacker can connect to the exposed WebDriver service to execute arbitrary JavaScript, read and exfiltrate sensitive localStorage data including ACR telemetry, MAC addresses, ad-service credentials, and location data, inject persistent content onto the display, and access the window.hisense native bridge to perform filesystem read/write and system-state operations.

CVE-2026-123974.description: In all versions of PyTorch's TorchServe, a predictable extraction directory in /tmp lets a local user swap the model handler and run code as the TorchServe service account leading to local privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-123961.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 6.2c.884. This impacts the function setWiFiBasicConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. The manipulation of the argument KeyStr leads to buffer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

CVE-2026-123960.description: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 6.2c.884. This affects the function setWanConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Executing a manipulation of the argument pppoeUser/priDns/secDns can lead to buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-123959.description: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 6.2c.884. The impacted element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument langType results in buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-123615.description: imgproxy 3.3.0 before 4.0.17 contains an out-of-bounds heap read and write in the ICO loader's BMP header reconstruction (vips_foreign_load_ico_header in vips/icoload.c) when an ICO entry declares a tiny data size, causing unvalidated header fields to be read and written past the allocated buffer. Unauthenticated remote attackers can supply a crafted ICO image to corrupt adjacent heap chunk metadata, triggering a glibc abort that crashes the worker.

CVE-2026-123532.description: gix-fs in gitoxide before 0.24.1 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to capture NTLM credentials by supplying UNC symlink targets in a crafted repository. When a victim checks out the repository on Windows with symlinks enabled, gix_fs::symlink::create calls is_dir() on the UNC target, triggering SMB authentication that leaks the username, domain, and NTLMv2 hash.

CVE-2026-123531.description: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass service.maxitemsperpage by sending page=0 to /api/v1 list endpoints. Attackers can self-register and repeatedly request page=0 to force unbounded SQL queries, memory materialisation, and per-row query fan-out, degrading availability for other users.

CVE-2026-123528.description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows holders of revoked access tokens to keep authenticating because SetupTokenMiddleware skips session and account-status checks. Attackers with a stolen token can, after logout, password reset, or account disabling, mint OAuth sessions via /oauth/authorize or tk_ API tokens for persistent access.

CVE-2026-123523.description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory by requesting avatars at many distinct sizes. Attackers can upload a noisy avatar and fetch it at each size up to 1024, caching roughly a gigabyte per account without eviction and causing the API process to be OOM-killed.

CVE-2026-123519.description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust API process memory by uploading WeKan or vikunja-file imports with no item-count cap. Attackers can submit a ~22 MB WeKan JSON with hundreds of thousands of cards or duplicate IDs to the wekan migrate endpoint, triggering OOM and crashing the instance.

CVE-2026-122095.description: AsiaInfo BSS Platform 9.2 before 9.2.38 has a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the menu icon upload function. An authenticated user with ordinary application privileges can upload an SVG file containing embedded JavaScript, which is served from the application origin. Normal menu rendering uses an HTML element and does not execute the SVG script; exploitation requires a victim to load the uploaded SVG as a document (by directly navigating to its URL, or via

CVE-2026-121958.description: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has a heap out-of-bounds write in the RDPGFX client because the delete_surface callback truncates surface hash keys to 16 bits, leaving the surface table inconsistent so HashTable_GetKeys writes past its allocated key array. A malicious or man-in-the-middle RDP server can exploit this by creating surfaceId 0xFFFF, closing the RDPGFX channel, sending repeated DELETESURFACE PDUs, and then sending ENDFRAME or RESETGRAPHICS.

CVE-2026-121930.description: A weakness has been identified in Linksys WRT54GL 4.30.18. The affected element is the function system of the file apply.cgi of the component Ping Diagnostic. This manipulation of the argument ping_ip causes os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-121824.description: A vulnerability has been identified in armeria versions prior to 1.43.0, where processing malformed Thrift messages can cause excessive memory allocation, potentially resulting in denial of service.

CVE-2026-121823.description: A vulnerability has been identified in armeria versions prior to 1.43.0, where inconsistent request path normalization can allow unauthenticated attackers to bypass path-based access controls and access protected resources.

CVE-2026-121617.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Linksys E5600 1.1.0.26. Affected by this issue is the function init_multipart of the file /cgi-bin/upload_fw.cgi of the component Header Parser. The manipulation results in out-of-bounds write. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-121600.description: A flaw has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this vulnerability is the function setMacFilterRules of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component MAC Filter Handler. This manipulation of the argument addEffect causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

CVE-2026-121599.description: A vulnerability was detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected is the function setWiFiMultipleConfig/delWiFiMultipleConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Multi-SSID Configuration. The manipulation of the argument wepkey2/wepkey3 results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.
